children: traded higher on Wednesday after Barclays upgraded the drugmaker to Overweight from Underweight, citing a compelling risk-reward setup ahead of a major FDA decision affecting the company.
The upgrade comes as the company awaits the approval of its biosimilars targeting Simponi from Johnson & Johnson
The decisions expected on or before December 4 could materially change Alvotech’s

outlook, Barclays analyst Glen Santangelo wrote. "With the three aforementioned expected approvals in 4Q FY27, product revenue growth should be meaningful, creating what we view as a disproportionate risk/reward,” he added.

In his base case, the analyst sets an $8 per share target for the company, up from $4 previously, assuming a 15-16x multiple if the company records $270M-$290M in EBITDA next year, subject to the approval of all three drugs.

title: Alvotech wins double upgrade at Barclays on upcoming FDA decision
